name: Minamoto no Yoshitsune
source:
He is the half brother of Yoritomo, and the general of the rebellion against the shogunate. 

He has obtained non-human power by signing a contract with the Karasu-Tengu. Even though he has a depressing aura, he has natural talent for fighting. People are strongly attracted to his pure heart, one remove away from madness.

Organization: Rebellion
Interest: Training, sun bathing
